added.name: emotion_fearful_scared_helpless
added.label: Fearful / Scared / Helpless
added.reason: Helpless emphasizes blocked action, unlike the retained Frightened double flinch.

added.name: emotion_fearful_rejected_persecuted
added.label: Fearful / Rejected / Persecuted
added.reason: Persecuted suggests being pursued; repeated rearward checks differ from Excluded's held withdrawal.

added.name: emotion_fearful_threatened_nervous
added.label: Fearful / Threatened / Nervous
added.reason: Nervous uses small uneven checking turns rather than the larger sustained exposure retreat.

added.name: emotion_fearful_threatened_exposed
added.label: Fearful / Threatened / Exposed
added.reason: Exposed begins in visible openness before a protective withdrawal, unlike a repeated nervous scan.

added.name: emotion_angry_let_down

added.reason: Let down needs failed expectation; the original Hurt motion is reserved for Sad / Hurt.

added.name: emotion_angry_let_down_betrayed

added.reason: Betrayed juxtaposes initial openness and a sudden guarded look back; Resentful stays withdrawn.

added.name: emotion_angry_bitter_indignant
added.label: Angry / Bitter / Indignant
added.reason: Indignant expresses a firm objection with an upright head rather than Violated's protective contraction.

added.name: emotion_angry_distant_numb

added.name: emotion_angry_critical_dismissive
added.label: Angry / Critical / Dismissive
added.reason: Dismissive ends attention decisively, unlike Skeptical's continuing sideways inspection.
